subject: pri-af-td
title: PRI.AF.TD. ------ TR.
description: Diagram in CMOA(I)-13 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — Britain/Germany/Holland), second of two on book p219, paired with v2-p219-1. Continues the European creativity argument by holding affinity-tendency at the primary level against transformation. (C)PRI-AF-TD (the concept of primary affinity tendencies) is crossed with TR (transformation): the question is what primary-affinity-tendencies produces when crossed with transformation — the (c) prefix marking that primary-affinity-tendencies is being held conceptually (the structural design), and the transformation question is whether European creativity constitutes a transformative move. AFI (affinity insight) rises from the main line and carries AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and COS-D (cosmic dictates) in the upper-left cluster. TR is the partner at the upper-right. (R)INT (reality of intention) branches from the main line and carries ALT-D (alternative definitions) and ACT (activism). ACT carries (R)TM (the reality of terminology—or terms of a definition), from which APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) hangs, and SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics), which carries FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics) at the lower-right. IST-F (isolated focus) anchors the right margin. The (r) prefix on INT registers that intention must actually obtain for the output cluster (social-reality-dynamics, isolated-focus, fundamental-dynamics) that hangs beneath it.
